data.title: 雷姆 · 烛影摇曳的无悔奉献
data.action: 跪在床铺中央，双手在胸前交扣成祈祷姿势，水蓝短发微掩单眼，澄澈蓝眸泛着幸福的泪光，脸上挂着纯粹至极的依恋微笑。
data.location: 罗兹瓦尔宅邸客房床榻，黄铜烛台上的白色蜡烛正静静淌下烛泪
data.timeOfDay: 深夜万籁俱寂的私密倾诉
data.lighting: 单支蜡烛的温润暖光投射在水蓝发丝与泪珠上，折射出钻石般的璀璨微光
data.camera: side view, eye level, medium shot
data.mood: 世界级女主角的绝对深情，无保留的献祭般温柔与至高幸福感
data.description: 罗兹瓦尔宅邸客房床榻，黄铜烛台上的白色蜡烛正静静淌下烛泪。跪在床铺中央，双手在胸前交扣成祈祷姿势，水蓝短发微掩单眼，澄澈蓝眸泛着幸福的泪光，脸上挂着纯粹至极的依恋微笑。 她微微抬眸轻语——“能够像现在这样，只为了昴一个人换上最美丽的衣裳……雷姆的整个世界，都已经被昴填满了。”
data.promptProse: Kneeling gracefully on the guest bed inside Roswaal's quiet manor at midnight, Rem wears a sky-blue sheer floral-lace babydoll dress tied with white satin ribbon bows at the bust. Clasping both hands at her chest with tear-bright, purely devoted eyes, she is illuminated by the soft amber glow of a dripping white candle in its brass holder.
data.animaCaption: Kneeling gently on the mansion guest bed with both hands clasped at her chest in a sky-blue sheer floral-lace babydoll tied with white satin bows, she gazes toward the viewer with happy, glistening tears and wholehearted devotion. A single brass candlestick warms the quiet room.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a sky-blue semi-sheer floral-lace babydoll nightdress tied at the ruffled empire waist with pure white satin ribbon bows.
